content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Punjab Family Court Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://tarntaran.dcourts.gov.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 09-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Principal Judge Family Court Tarn Taran is conducting the recruitment for Family Counsellor and Child Counsellor posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 7 vacancies are available for Family Counsellor and Child Counsellor posts combined across the department.

faq.question: Q3. What are the available post names in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts are Family Counsellor and Child Counsellor under the Principal Judge Family Court Tarn Taran.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted through offline mode by downloading the form and sending it via post to the designated address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of the completed offline application form is 09-10-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the minimum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must be at least 35 years of age to be eligible for applying to these various posts.

faq.question: Q7. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates need a graduate degree preferably in Social Science, Sociology, Psychology, Clinical Psychiatry, or Law with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for applying?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General, OBC, SC, and ST categories as the fee is listed as Nil.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the candidates involves an Interaction round scheduled by the recruitment authority.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to download the application form?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website at https://tarntaran.dcourts.gov.in/ to obtain the notification and application form.
